$comment: Broad query invalidation in apps/web/src, one entry per site. Kinds: unkeyed (no filter), predicate (a predicate with no key visits every cached query), space-wide (a ["spaces"], ["spaces", id] or ["annotations", id] prefix without exact: true, which also refetches open documents). Invalidate the exact keys a change touched instead. Checked by bun run perf:guards; see docs/performance.md.

sites.why: A restore replaced the whole workspace: every cached query is stale.
A restore replaced the whole workspace, and its id could not be read: every cached query is stale.
After a Space's thread socket reconnects, its thread lists and details may have missed events; thread keys carry the Space inside a location key.
Annotation events name the annotation, not its document, so the Space's annotation lists read again (only those on screen).
After a reconnect the tab may have missed any change in the Space: mark it stale without refetching; content at a revision is excluded.
After a reconnect, annotation lists on screen read again; the events they missed are unknown.
When the last subscriber leaves, nothing keeps the Space current: mark it stale without refetching; content at a revision is excluded.
